title: Allowed-host hint requests a source URL that the field rejects
reproduction: Pre-fix host controls: the values scan found 43 localized declarations in addition to the default, and the localized hostname TextView had no labelFor. Add/edit use the same layout and hostname validator.
expected: All locales inherit one valid hostname example; the existing localized hostname label is associated with the input independently of its hint.
observed: Source URL/link/address hints shadowed the corrected default in 43 locales. Allowed-host entry did not associate its label with the field as the blocked and redirected dialogs do.
fix: Use a single nontranslatable example.org; remove the obsolete declaration in each of the 43 locale files. CI also normalized 13 of their XML headers. Point the existing localized hostname label at the EditText. No change to validation or handling of multiple lines.
test_evidence: Both tests in scripts/tests/test_allowed_host_resources.py failed before and passed after. Isolated SDK 36 link: only default example.org; compiled labelFor equals field ID and hint references the example. Separate original, hint-only and CI-final hashes in post-beta-res-hint-removals.csv; no whole-file review or Android/TalkBack claim for these removals.

title: Empty rule tab implies that adding a subscription will populate a source-hidden view
reproduction: Source trace, not run: hide downloaded sources and open a tab with no user rules and an empty query.
expected: Describe the current tab and filter without implying there are no rules elsewhere.
observed: The no-rules state depended on the filtered adapter count, yet suggested subscribing regardless of the source visibility setting.
fix: Changed default empty title and message to scope the claim to this view and mention hidden filter-list rules.
test_evidence: AbstractListFragment, ListsFilter and list menu traced; default values compiled and linked. No runtime toggle, paging or accessibility exercise.

title: Android strips intended quotes around the hostname in the delete confirmation
reproduction: Host reproduction: compile and link the old default resource, then inspect the delete prompt in the resource table.
expected: The confirmation visibly delimits the rule identifier and preserves its string argument.
observed: AAPT2 dropped the unescaped straight quotes and produced Delete %1$s from your rules? in the pre-fix table.
fix: Used literal typographic quotes around the unchanged %1$s placeholder in the default.
test_evidence: Before/after AAPT2 table inspected; Java Formatter on the linked value produced Delete “*.example.org” from your rules?. No dialog rendering, deletion or screen-reader test.

title: Preference summaries misstate backup contents and destination
reproduction: Source trace, not run: compare the two preference summaries with CreateDocument/OpenDocument, BackupExporter.makeBackup and BackupImporter.
expected: Describe the user-chosen document and both personal rules and filter sources, without implying a full app-settings backup.
observed: Default summaries described block rules and the backup summary specified external storage; the picker is not restricted to that destination and the data includes three rule types plus sources.
fix: Corrected default and Hebrew backup and restore summaries. In other locales 35 backup and 32 restore summaries remain misleading; post-beta-res-localized-overrides.csv lists exact keys and distinguishes incomplete or neutral text.
test_evidence: Preferences and export/import paths inspected. Default and Hebrew values compiled and linked; both Hebrew values in the isolated package matched the edited XML. No picker, provider, export, restore or device test in this audit.

title: Space and generic hosts write errors misdirect users to Magisk and reboot
reproduction: Source trace, not run: compare the pre-write capacity rejection with the remount/copy failure branch in RootModel.copyHostsFile.
expected: Explain a capacity failure as such; make Magisk advice conditional for a write failure.
observed: The two detail messages prescribed Magisk/reboot although the capacity check precedes writing and not every write failure involves Magisk.
fix: Corrected both detail keys in the default and Hebrew resources. Remaining localized details and the distinct Vietnamese capacity omission are in post-beta-res-localized-overrides.csv.
test_evidence: Both values files compiled and linked. Three JVM bidi probes checked root, Magisk and Systemless hosts in Hebrew RTL prose only. No root operation, device rendering or spoken-order test.

title: Install error blames an installer or settings launch that may never have been attempted
reproduction: Source trace, not run: follow a processing exception before installer launch in handleTerminalDownload or resumePendingInstall.
expected: Describe inability to start installation without asserting which launch failed.
observed: The same INSTALL_FAILED state covers launch failure and earlier exceptions, but its text specifically blamed opening the installer or permission settings.
fix: Changed default INSTALL_FAILED text to say installation could not start and suggest a retry.
test_evidence: Receiver catch paths and InstallDownloadStatus mapping inspected; values compiled and linked. No exception injection, permission UI, installer launch or retry executed.

title: Donation and sponsorship button text does not consistently identify the actions
reproduction: Source trace, not run: compare the two support button labels in the nine affected qualifier files with their distinct click destinations.
expected: The two text labels identify donating and sponsoring rather than a sponsor/person.
observed: The scoped overrides included recipient nouns, an untranslated Sponsor label and ambiguous donation wording; the destinations themselves were distinct.
fix: Corrected scoped button labels for el, es, fa, it, pl, pt-rBR, sk, zh and zh-rTW; no links or button behavior changed.
test_evidence: Nine qualifier files compiled and linked; labels compared with UpdateActivity.bindListeners. Formatter samples exercised progress strings, not these labels. No button activation, clipping or TalkBack test.

title: Dutch download notification mixes English and Dutch
reproduction: Source trace, not run: inspect the Dutch description passed by UpdateModel to the DownloadManager request.
expected: Use Dutch wording for a download in progress.
observed: The Dutch description started with the English word Downloading.
fix: Replaced the values-nl description with a Dutch in-progress sentence.
test_evidence: Resource text and DownloadManager request traced; localized values compiled and linked. No posted notification, system rendering or download observed.

title: Current-version header uses an incorrect verb form and describes the user instead of the app
reproduction: Source trace, not run: inspect the pt-rBR heading selected by markUpToDate for a current manifest.
expected: Say AdAway is up to date in Brazilian Portuguese.
observed: Você esta atualizado omitted the verbal accent and described the user as updated.
fix: Changed the pt-rBR heading to O AdAway está atualizado.
test_evidence: Qualifier text and heading selection inspected; resource compiled and linked. No manifest fetch, activity rendering or locale-device test.

title: Busy message asserts that a filter update is running even for other lock owners
reproduction: Source trace, not run: examine a second source operation while restore, rule mutation or protection change owns the coordinator lease.
expected: Tell the user another operation is in progress and to wait and retry; do not guess its owner.
observed: The default message and details identified a filter update even though the shared gate can reject an operation held for another reason. Hebrew lacked both overrides.
fix: Made both default strings operation-neutral and supplied Hebrew title and retry details.
test_evidence: Lease ownership, error mapping and both values files inspected; all 18 Hebrew error keys matched the defaults and linked. No concurrent operations, runtime delivery or TalkBack test.
